ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, the horizontal axis is years, marking time points such as 1920, 1945, 1970, 1995, and 2020; the vertical axis is the percentage of urbanization level. The curve shows that the U.S. urbanization level rose from about 51.2% in 1920 to about 56.5% in 1945, and then to about 73.6% in 1970, among which “A” is marked in the rapid rising stage around 1945—1970. The figure also marks urbanization process information such as migration from small towns to big cities. Reasoning: The question asks about the leading industry of the regional economy in stage A. Stage A corresponds to the period when urbanization in developed countries rapidly increased and entered a relatively high urbanization level. According to the evolution laws of urbanization and industrial structure in developed countries, the economic structure will gradually shift from being led by manufacturing and other secondary industries to being led by services, so in this stage the tertiary industry became the leading industry of the regional economy.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：图中美国城市化水平在1945—1970年前后快速上升，甲标在这一快速上升阶段。再结合题干问的是甲阶段的主导产业。根据发达国家城市化进程规律，快速城市化进入较高水平后，经济结构由制造业主导逐渐转向服务业主导。因此回答：第三产业成为区域经济的主导产业。

推理：题目问甲阶段区域经济的主导产业。甲阶段对应发达国家城市化快速提高并进入较高城市化水平的时期。按照发达国家城市化和产业结构演变规律，经济结构会由制造业等第二产业主导逐渐转向服务业主导，因此这一阶段第三产业成为区域经济的主导产业。
